_comment: Apex gist integrity gate (DATA, not code). A live apex ADR supersedes archived members and is supposed to carry their ratified substance forward. The consolidation that produced the ten live apexes cut every carried block at a fixed CHARACTER budget and the member list itself at a fixed COUNT of 60. Neither cut left a marker, so the result is well-formed Markdown that READS as complete while asserting less than was ratified — nobody can tell a truncated gist from a deliberately terse one. That is why this gate decides CUT rather than SHORT: it looks for the mechanical signature of a budget cut (a block ending inside a word, a block leaving a code fence open, a member named in supersedes that the body never carries) plus one semantic cross-check (a topic the members demonstrably carry and the apex never mentions). ALL repo-specifics are DATA — another repo adopts this gate by repointing these values.

topics._comment: The one topic established by MEASUREMENT rather than guessed. Positive control: this needle set over the archived corpus returns 6 files and 52 lines, which is what proves the pattern can match at all; the same set over all ten live apexes returns 0. Members ADR-0147 (28 lines) and ADR-0248 (18) close onto live apexes and carry the substance that vanished. Deliberately NOT extended with speculative topics: an unmeasured needle list is ceremony, and a needle that never fires cannot be told from a corpus that is clean.
topics.name: confidential-computing

measured._comment: ENFORCED shrink-only ceilings, pinned by EQUALITY in findings_equal_the_frozen_ceilings, with the census pinned separately in census_equals_the_frozen_values and asserted FIRST. Equality rather than <= is deliberate and matches the sibling adr-citation-closure gate: a NEW truncation exceeds the ceiling and fails, and a REPAIRED one falls below it and also fails, forcing the ceiling down in the same change that does the repair. The census is the anti-vacuity anchor — a repaired corpus and a collapsed walk both report fewer findings, and only the census distinguishes them. Re-derive every value by RUNNING this gate and reading 'observed N' from its own assertion; never by arithmetic.
measured._first_freeze_2026_08_09: Baseline against dev at 885794461. EVERY value below was read from this gate's own 'observed N' assertion, never computed, and every one carries an independent cross-check because a first freeze has no prior ratchet to disagree with. apex_member_without_gist 132 = the 66 tail members of ADR-0700 plus the 66 of ADR-0709, derived separately by set-differencing each apex `supersedes:` list against its gist bullets; the other eight apexes are complete on this code. apex_gist_unclosed_fence 48 = 19 gist bullets + 29 residual blocks counted separately by run length of ``` . apex_topic_dropped 2 = exactly ADR-0700 and ADR-0709, predicted BEFORE the run from the six archived members carrying the needles and their superseded_by chains, and matched. apex_member_without_residual 1 = ADR-65 under ADR-0709, the single member with no residual at all.
measured._parse_recovery_attribution: An earlier run of this same gate reported apex_member_without_gist 154 and blocks 617. Those numbers were NOT frozen, because 154 disagreed with a hand-derived 132 and an unexplained number must not become a ceiling. The gap was the gate's own blind spot: strip_gist_leadin returned None for the 22 bullets whose TITLE is cut mid-parenthesis, so those blocks left the census entirely and their members counted as having no gist at all. Recovering them moves blocks 617 -> 639 (+22, exactly the recovered bullets), apex_member_without_gist 154 -> 132 (agreeing with the independent derivation), and apex_gist_truncated_midword 533 -> 552 (+19, being the recovered bodies that are themselves cut mid-word). The 22 are now reported under their own code instead of vanishing. This is the failure mode the ratchet is least able to catch on its own: a parser that drops what it cannot read reports a SMALLER finding count, which is indistinguishable from a repair.
measured._repair_direction: This gate ratchets; it does not repair. The corpus repair is a GENERATOR job, not a hand job — 386 members across two carry sites is 639 blocks, and hand-authoring 639 summaries would substitute one lane's paraphrase for ratified text, which is the same defect with a different author. The three loss classes need different treatment and only the first is purely mechanical: (1) the 132 missing gists have an intact residual in the same file to derive from; (2) the 552 cut bodies and 48 broken fences need re-deriving from the archived member at a BLOCK boundary rather than a byte budget, with an explicit elision marker and a pointer to the member, so a shortened gist READS as shortened; (3) the 2 dropped topics are genuine substantive loss and need ratified prose, not a longer prefix.
